newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to ban federal funding for human cloning.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to ban federal funding for human cloning.

text.p: President Bill Clinton has decided to issue a directive banning federal funding for research into cloning human beings, the White House said on Tuesday.

Clinton was to formally sign the directive during an Oval Office ceremony, during which he was to call for a temporary moratorium on all human cloning pending the outcome of a review by a federal advisory panel.
Clinton has asked the National Bioethics Advisory Commission to review the legal and ethical issues involved and to report its findings, a White House statement said.

An announcement by British scientists last month that they had successfully cloned a sheep using cells from an adult animal has sparked fears of a similar experiment using human cells and touched off debate around the world on the ethics of such experiments.
Clinton was to announce the ban in an Oval office ceremony shortly.
